headline: MIN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.67 at CLE 5.09, with a projected total of 8.76. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: MIN moved -0.58 runs while CLE moved +0.86, changing the projected margin by -1.44 runs. NRFI probability rose +30.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Andrew Morris has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Chase DeLauter, Byron Buxton, Ryan Jeffers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kody Clemens, Matt Wallner because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
